{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":1410,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax))","note":"The attacker-controlled pattern is compiled and stored in the shared search_re slot before execution."},

{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},

{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4949,"var":"en->te.Then","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Then);","note":"Conditional subtrees are also recursively analyzed, increasing the chance of hitting the vulnerable optimizer path with complex patterns."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed against the subject string; if the vulnerable compiler state is reached, the crash manifests during regex processing."}
